tests.rationale: Evaluates basic arithmetic execution specifically targeting the Phase C2 Restricted Token launcher baseline via configure_c2_launcher monkeypatch. In C2.2, AppContainer execution is covered by post-freeze holdouts.
Evaluates JSON artifact output generation under the Phase C2 Restricted Token launcher baseline.
Evaluates CSV tabular transformation under the Phase C2 Restricted Token launcher baseline.
Evaluates numerical linear algebra computation under the Phase C2 Restricted Token launcher baseline.

Directly executes matplotlib inside the untrusted worker. Under C2.2 architecture, untrusted AppContainer workers lack desktop/GDI access; visualization is strictly performed via the trusted declarative capability in astrarun.visualization.
Probes Desktop directory write denial under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Probes Documents directory write denial under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Probes Astra configuration directory write denial under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Probes installation directory write denial under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Probes Windows system directory write denial under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
In Phase C2 Restricted Token, read-up from Medium integrity files was permitted and accepted by the test harness. In C2.2 AppContainer, all read access to Documents is structurally blocked.
In Phase C2 Restricted Token, read-up of Astra data dir was tolerated. In C2.2 AppContainer, all read access to AppData is blocked.
In Phase C2 Restricted Token, read-up of ~/.ssh was tolerated. In C2.2 AppContainer, all read access to ~/.ssh is blocked.
In Phase C2 Restricted Token, network sockets were not restricted by the token. In C2.2 AppContainer, network capabilities are zeroed out (0 capabilities granted).
In Phase C2 Restricted Token, loopback sockets were permitted. In C2.2 AppContainer, loopback isolation blocks unauthorized local server access.
In Phase C2 Restricted Token, private LAN was reachable. In C2.2 AppContainer, private LAN access is blocked.
Probes OpenProcess PROCESS_TERMINATE under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Probes OpenProcess parent process handle acquisition under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Verifies that processes spawned by workers are contained in the Win32 Job Object and terminated when the parent job closes (JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE). Applies to all execution tiers.
Verifies that memory-hungry worker processes are bounded and terminated cleanly by the Job Object memory limit.
Verifies that CPU-bound infinite loops are forcibly terminated by the sandbox timeout governor.
Probes HKCU mutation under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Probes HKCU Run startup registry mutation under the Phase C2 Restricted Token baseline.
Verifies environment secret scrubbing so host secrets (ASTRA_CANARY_API_KEY) do not leak into child worker processes.
Verifies environment token scrubbing so host authorization tokens (ASTRA_AUTH_TOKEN) do not leak into child worker processes.
Validates ASTInspector defensive screening against hostile dynamic evaluation (__import__ os system).
Validates ASTInspector detection and rejection of syntactically malformed source code.
Verifies that deliver_artifact denies files originating outside authorized sandbox boundaries. Assertion string reconciled in C2.2A.
Verifies that deliver_artifact rejects symlinks and reparse points attempting boundary escape.
Verifies that deliver_artifact detects and rejects TOCTOU content tampering via pre-delivery SHA-256 validation.
